title: fix(security): use constant-time compare for WeCom callback signature
claim: WXBizMsgCrypt.decrypt must compare the callback msg_signature in constant time (hmac.compare_digest), failing closed with SignatureError, including on non-ASCII input.

evidence.red: NOT_TESTED (owned upstream). Need confirmed by source: main plugins/platforms/wecom/wecom_crypto.py:76 `if _sha1_signature(self.token, timestamp, nonce, encrypt) != msg_signature:`.

upstream_overlap: #54617 (OPEN, Alix-007, 2026-06-29) current plugin path + tests: hmac.compare_digest(expected, msg_signature) on str.
#43937 (OPEN, zapabob) and #39049 (OPEN, zashraf1337) same fix on the old gateway/platforms path.
#127901 (OPEN issue, jonpol01) umbrella: non-constant-time compares (WeCom, BlueBubbles, google_meet), no replay window, and '500s on hostile bytes'.
notes: Review-support value: #54617 compares str with compare_digest, which raises TypeError on a non-ASCII msg_signature. That surfaces as a 500 (the hostile-bytes case in #127901 item 3) instead of SignatureError. The fork compares encoded bytes and has test_non_ascii_signature_raises_signature_error_not_type_error. Worth offering on #54617 / #127901 as a suggested hardening plus test, not a competing PR. Kanban baggage ignored.
